objective: Integrate new generic numerical runtime with the exact conserved organism/body, then run seconds-long stage3 odor conditions. Motor remains transversal and may improve when actual integration requires it.

numerical_routes.A: Device-native generic target/rate graph stepping with explicit epoch input updates and physical-event waveform ports; maintain original equations, body1ms and validated partition boundaries. Reuse native engine ownership/stream/finite-check infrastructure.
numerical_routes.B: Existing native high-order explicit backend via a captured full-operator adapter if its cost/precision is better; no omitted mass/event/history. Not presumed suitable.
numerical_routes.C: Full monolithic descriptor export with sparse mass and event scheduling; deferred unless partitioned transport demonstrably cannot conserve model. Do not silently replace specialized modules with rate proxies.

biological_hypotheses.A: Lateral sensory contrast attenuated or distorted before descending readout; compare ORN and both PN routes with actual downstream inputs.
biological_hypotheses.B: Common/basal state or initial history dominates response; compare paired sham/uniform and side differences without recalibrating after seeing outcome.
biological_hypotheses.C: Descending readout or body mapping loses/reverses an available neural contrast; compare actual DN signals, consumed commands and body response, then selective withdrawal if indicated.

initial_conditions: Start from conserved settled700ms checkpoint; reproduce no-ORN-rescaling engineering branch with inherited reader/tau modifications explicitly labelled. No new physiological fit. Clean40ms preparation, then each condition1s if transport gates pass.

transport_screen.reference: Corrected event-aware original equations and finer partition; initial same state; include checkpoints and incoming/outgoing ports, not just final yaw.
transport_screen.counts_clocks_flags: exact in paired short transport; long timing and relevant event identity recorded

behavior: Record historical100ms criterion only at that window, and continuous1s yaw/sensory/motor trajectories; do not relabel an expanded-window angle as historical PASS. No new stage3 admission absent motor reader independent grounding/withdrawal/restart controls.

preimplementation.observed_limitation: Generic smooth-ODE benchmark has no direct adapter for actual heterogenous checkpoint; original runtime couples specialized physical states and events.
preimplementation.operation: Generic device graph integrator receives target/rate operator with explicit mutable boundary buffers and time-resolved owned-state ports; callbacks/graphs execute on one stream with persistent finite flag.
preimplementation.legal_information: Current physical state and declared equations/topology, held legal sensor inputs and timestamped physical events; no desired direction or answers.
preimplementation.difference: Imports actual physical operator via adapter rather than synthetic replacement; retains existing model-specific equations outside generic execution.
preimplementation.falsifier: Changing boundary input or alternating physical events changes the appropriate stage while no stale captured allocation persists; original corrected reference trajectory matches frozen limits.

stop_rules: Preserve failed attempts; repair implementation bugs and repeat affected checks, never tune physiology/error criteria to obtain PASS. Run actual seconds only if short transport passes. If unsupported semantics block faithful integration, report exact missing capability and actual partial progress.
scope: No Codex subagents; ChatGPT review actual evidence, Jev advisory routing only. Historical source tree read-only.
